briefings.title: The Evolving AI Landscape: A Conversation between SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and BlackRock's Tony Kim
briefings.tldr: SpaceX Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen and BlackRock Global Technology Team Head Tony Kim discussed SpaceX's rapid scaling into AI infrastructure, projecting over $100 billion in annualized run rate (ARR) by the end of 2026, driven by a 1-year terrestrial compute payback and upcoming orbital compute deployments starting next year.

briefings.title: Starship - The Holy Grail of Rocketry
briefings.tldr: Fully reusable rockets like SpaceX's Starship are the key to unlocking space exploration, demonstrated through historic milestones including Falcon 9 booster landings and the successful ocean recovery and data retrieval of Starship Ship 40.

briefings.title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger
briefings.tldr: Gwynne Shotwell and Elon Musk detailed massive infrastructure expansions across SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI—highlighting plans for Mars within the decade, space-based compute data centers, and a chip fabrication facility ("Terafab")—while proposing cross-company and international AI peer-review test harnesses to mitigate existential risks.

briefings.title: I Will Hold My SpaceX Shares Forever, Says Sequoia's Maguire
briefings.tldr: Sequoia Capital Partner Shaun Maguire outlines a hyper-bullish, long-term thesis on SpaceX, asserting that its unique multi-layered model—spanning dominant launch capabilities, elite engineering talent, and rapid scaling of both terrestrial and orbital AI compute—makes it a compounding powerhouse whose shares he plans to hold "forever."

briefings.title: The SpaceX IPO: Science Fiction or Serious Investment? | The Weekly Wrap
briefings.tldr: SpaceX's upcoming IPO seeks an unprecedented $1.75 to $2 trillion valuation (~100x sales) that relies on sci-fi narrative appeal and relaxed Nasdaq index rules rather than its decelerating fundamentals.

briefings.title: Starship - Test Like You Fly

people.name: Elon Musk
people.role: Founder, CEO, and Chief Engineer, SpaceX

briefings.tldr: SpaceX is transitioning to Starship Version 3 (V3), a "clean-sheet" redesign optimized for mass production and orbital propellant transfer, using a "test like you fly" philosophy to iterate through hardware failures toward the ultimate goal of Mars colonization.

briefings.title: NEVER bet against Elon Musk: CEO
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk’s merger of SpaceX and xAI creates a $1.25 trillion entity poised for a historic IPO, signaling a massive bet on space-based AI infrastructure and a departure from traditional government economic metrics toward real-time data.
